headline: Approved $1,246,635 water and sewer upgrades at Boston Road Mobile Home Park and $425,000 in Hubbard Park grant money.
summary: Approved a $5,000,000 Housing Works infrastructure project with no match, plus a $1,000,000 grant for the public beach at Five Mile Pond. A first-steps vote of 12-0 sent an amendment to Chapter 385 on dirt bikes to committee.
decisions: Approved the Eversource petition for Walnut Street, 12-0.
Approved the Eversource petition for N Branch Parkway, 12-0.
Accepted the $300.00 Elder Affairs donation, called together without objection.
Accepted the $2,500 donation from The Jeffrey Speller Foundation 4 Change for Parks, called together without objection.
Approved the $425,000 PARC grant, which requires a city match, for improvements and accessibility at Hubbard Park, 12-0.
Approved the $450,000 MassDev Underutilized Properties Program grant with no match, 12-0.
Approved the $500,000 MassDev Underutilized Properties Program grant with no match, 12-0.
Approved the $1,000,000 Land and Water Conservation Fund grant, which requires a match, for renovations to the public beach at Five Mile Pond, 12-0.
Approved the $1,246,635 Housing Works infrastructure grant for water and sewer upgrades at the Boston Road Mobile Home Park, 12-0.
Approved the $5,000,000 Housing Works infrastructure project with no match, 12-0.
Approved the SPS supplemental budget for an increase in charter school tuition state aid, 11-0, with Brian Santaniello away and Maria Perez absent.
Sent the amendment to Chapter 385 on dirt bikes to committee after a 12-0 first-steps vote.
